comments.author: @Basta11
comments.text:
A lot of Filipinos have 2 first names. Many popular second names I've seen are May, Ray, Jay, Kay,  Marie, Ann, Lou, Lee, Joe, Belle.. 

May comes from Mary / Maria. Rae/Ray from Rachel. Kay - Katrina. Jay from Joe / Jose / Joseph. 

Filipinos love doubling up the names for nicknames - AnnAnn, Kaykay, Maymay, Rayray, Loulou, Leelee. YumYum from Miriam, Kenken from Karen. Gelgel from Angela. JunJun from Junior. Manman - Manny / Emmanuel. 

Like my second name is Louie, and it becomes wee wee. So when I came to America, I just went by my first name.
